Best app on the planet. In the age of subscriptions and the common practice of holding your stuff hostage on a platform's server, Obsidian is sweet relief. Your data lives on your device, and is readable by any normal text editor, so if Obsidian were to ever go unmaintained, your stuff is safe. You can also fully customize your experience with community plugins and themes. And surprisingly, most of the community stuff works on Android with only minor bugs if that. It's truly extraordinary.

As productivity tools go, this is amazing, Obsidian I think will grow more in my day-to-day as a tool. Recording notes quickly, is a thing of real importance. I've been using Obsidian for 4 years. I can't imagine using it only on mobile, but as an extension of the desktop app, the mobile version is fantastic. The only thing that I really miss is faster syncing or background syncing. With the current system I need to wait usually 20-30 seconds until everything is synced to mobile when I open the app. That makes quickly opening the app to jot something down quite frustrating. I use my phone's native note taking app for that.
